svg.title: TabICL v2 - classifier
svg.desc: soda-inria - column set transformer -> row encoder -> in-context stack · 27.6 M parameters. Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); LayerNorm: layer normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads). How to read: three bands: the phases, then the stages in them, then each stage's sublayers summed over all of its stacked blocks; width: parameters, on one linear scale for the whole figure; a stage with no listed sublayers fills its own width in the sublayer band; embedding / encoder (its sublayers in a muted shade); attention (its sublayers in a muted shade); feed-forward (its sublayers in a muted shade); normalisation (its sublayers in a muted shade); decoder head (its sublayers in a muted shade); stages with no parameters (the input, a weightless embedding, the prediction) have no width and are not drawn.
